inventory.gap_count_method: Count all entries in .records[].gaps[] from a fresh npm run --silent data:gaps report.
inventory.selection_note: Next ten evidence-found atomic fields in the fresh queue after excluding B119-B121 targets and adjacent fields recently audited but left open.

scope.research_boundary: Evidence-only Luna Max review; inspect only the frozen records, attempts and their accepted sources first. Work one exact candidate and one source at a time. Recheck one current primary exact-model source only where needed. Return direct source URLs, access date, source class, supported claim and caveat for each disposition. Primary writer integrates any supported result.
excluded: No fields outside the ten frozen targets.
Do not reopen unresolved B119-B121 fields or duplicate those audits.
Do not transfer model identity, construction, build, weight or market claims between Upland or Viqi products.
No new image records, third-party image hosting or rights assumptions.
